thread:
arya: Heads-up: sudden uptick in Pending GPU pods in us-east1-b, mostly tiny-infer-* jobs. Scheduler cpu/mem for solver shot up and we hit a few solver OOMs.
marco: I see it. 48 Pending now, clustered on two nvlink racks. Network egress to artifact-store spiked ~3x.
felix: Quick log excerpt from scheduler: 
```
E0610 11:04:12 solver.go:350] placement attempt=31 combinations=1.2e6 mem=1.9GB
E0610 11:04:12 solver.go:351] runtime: out of memory
E0610 11:04:13 solver.go:372] reducedSearchDepth -> retry
E0610 11:04:14 scheduler.go:412] fallback heuristic -> binding greedy tiny-infer-*
```
priya: That fallback is the kicker: big training pods get preempted then tiny jobs immediately fill the GPU and we get churn. Also saw label-syncer churned `gpu-family` labels earlier today.
arya: Two parallel levers: reduce solver search depth canary + introduce a short "recently-freed" cooldown that prevents best-effort/ephemeral pods from binding to nodes for N seconds after preemption.
marco: Canary commands I ran: `kubectl -n infra patch deployment scheduler --type='json' -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/args/","value":["--placement-search-depth=3"]}]'` (canary to 1 scheduler instance).
felix: Also put a kube-admission quick patch to label ephemeral pods with `ephemeral=true` (mutating webhook override) so we can target them for cooldown.
priya: Ops-bot opened INC-2024-8490 severity=high and assigned to eng-platform.
arya: After canary for 10min: solver OOMs decreased from ~30/min to 2/min. Pending dropped to 7. However packing fragmentation rose slightly (binpack 95p +9%).
marco: Tradeoff seems acceptable short-term. We should still implement cooldown to avoid preempt cascades. Idea: admission controller adds `schedule-delay:30s` annotation for `ephemeral=true` and scheduler respects that by skipping nodes with `recently-freed=true` label on nodes for 30s.
felix: Implemented naive version: controller labels nodes on preempt with `recently-freed-ts=<unix>` and webhook rejects immediate ephemerals if now - recently-freed-ts < 30. Canaryed in us-east1-b, worked: preempt churn dropped ~80%.
priya: Follow-ups: - Add metric for solver "combinations" and mem usage - Harden label-syncer (stop permitting label renames for gpu-family) - Add a flag in webhook to make schedule-delay configurable per job class.
arya: Cost ops: finance noted potential +5-10% burn if we keep relaxed solver depth long-term. We'll document duration-based rollouts.
marco: I'll draft the post-incident runbook and a cfg change PR for the webhook + scheduler flag.
felix: Leaving canaries for 1h then rolling regionwide if stable. Thanks. :thumbsup:
